## Practicum 4a: Objectives
* Compare an implementation with a world map
* Designing model measurements
* Summarizing the results of an experiment

## Challenge you were left with last practical
* Complete a the python disersal model translation:
  * [incomplete_dispersal_worldmap](https://wimpouw.github.io/multi_agent_systems_practicum/models/dispersal_python_model_incomplete.zip)
* I will give you an implementaiton today

## Recap: Basics Mesa
* Agent class (`class MyAgent(mesa.CellAgent): ...`)
  * Agent behavior (e.g., `def shout_out(self): ...`)
* Model class (`class MyModel(mesa.Model): ...`)
  * Space (`self.grid = OrthogoalMooreGrid(...)`)
  * Agent creation (`MyAgent.create_agents(...)`)
  * Step (`def step(self): ...`)
* Visualization server (`page = SolaraViz(model, [spaceviz], name="Grid Agent")`)
  * Solara vizualization (`make_space_component`)

## Recap: Further functionality Mesa
* Data collection after model run
  * Data collector (`self.datacollector = mesa.DataCollector(...)`)
    * Collecting data (`self.datacollector.collect(self)`)
* Running multiple models using Batch runner
  * Batch runner (`batch_run = mesa.BatchRunner(...)`)
   
## Project
* So a python mesa model should not feel so alien anymore
  * You have done some coding up from scratch
  * You should know what to look for

## Today: Coding with a pre-existing model
* Inspired by the Netlogo model
  * [Netlogo Dispersal model](https://wimpouw.github.io/multi_agent_systems_practicum/models/dispersal_netlogo.zip)
* Python implementation: 
  * [Dispersal model with worldmap](https://wimpouw.github.io/multi_agent_systems_practicum/models/dispersal_python_model_complete.zip)

## Practicum 4: Objectives
* Kets go through the implementation of the dispersal model
* Design a measurment to test whether humans are more likely to show up in Asia versus Europe
* Invent a setting of the model where the dispersal behavior becomes more probabilistic and assymetric
* Run experiments with several seeds, with and without the change to the model
* Summarize the results of the experiment
